name: -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting
title: -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting
description:
The -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fittings are precision CNC-machined to connect male O-Ring Boss (ORB) ports while providing a compact 90-degree routing solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, hydraulic, and power steering systems. The swivel design allows for easy clocking and precise alignment, ensuring a secure, leak-free seal without compromising installation flexibility.

Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process, these ORB swivel fittings deliver exceptional strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. The straight-thread ORB design seals with an integrated O-ring, providing reliable performance in high-pressure and high-temperature environments.

Compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuel, pump gas, diesel, oil, coolant, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, and air systems, these fittings are ideal for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for maximum fluid velocity in tight engine bays.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
